articles.title: Supreme Court Says No to Trump's Mail Ballot Limits
articles.summary: The Supreme Court said no to President Trump's plan to change mail-in voting rules just before the midterm elections. The ruling lets states keep using the same mail ballot systems they've used for years, which count for about a third of all votes.

articles.title: EPA Repeals Pollution Limits on Power Plants
articles.summary: The EPA announced it is repealing limits on greenhouse gas emissions from power plants. The head of the agency called it the largest deregulatory action in U.S. power sector history. Environmental groups plan to fight the decision in court.

articles.title: Trump Administration Loses Two Court Battles Over Immigration Rules
articles.summary: A federal judge blocked the Trump administration from limiting how long foreign students and journalists can stay in the U.S. At the same time, 22 states sued to stop a rule that could deny green cards to immigrants who use public benefits.
